narrative.overview: A rack of instruments on a graphite desk, lit from above. Surfaces are plates with a 1px seam, an inset highlight along the top edge and a corner tick; nothing floats and nothing glows. Two readers share the rack: a fan scanning sixty-one players and a coach reading a season's shape. Colour is information or absent, and blue/red survives only where a game's side decides first pick.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, chalk type, seam hairlines; plates lifted by an inset highlight.
One headline figure per card; every other mark 12px or smaller.
Charts draw their 50th percentile and name the better direction.
Mono is chrome — rail, tables, legends — never a card's voice.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is used on ≤2% of a screen: the active rail tab and a loss.

rules.name: The Crest Is Data Rule
rules.body: Team colour is sampled from the logo and clamped, never chosen.

rules.name: The Side Is an Exception Rule
rules.body: Blue and red appear only inside a game context, as an edge or labelled chip.

rules.name: The One Headline Rule
rules.body: A card carries exactly one figure at 22–24px.

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono never appears inside a player card.

rules.name: The Lit-From-Above Rule
rules.body: One gradient from the top of the page; nothing is lit from below or from a colour.

dos: Do lead each view with an h1 and a one-line answer.
Do lead each card with one figure at 22–24px.
Do draw the 50th percentile on any percentile chart.
Do sample team colour from the crest.
donts: Don't put JetBrains Mono inside a player card.
Don't leave a UA font on a control.
Don't blur or shadow a panel on flat ground.
Don't fill a card with a team colour.
Don't let a card's accessible name drop its numbers.
